title: 最大风险不是缺钱：是只盯短期利润，人类福祉谁来兜底？
speaker: Poman Lo

segments.en: A lot of the money that's been raised, whether that's in equity or debt markets, has gone into building the hardware and the infrastructure. And I wonder from your perspective, on the energy side,
segments.zh: 无论是权益资产还是债务市场筹集的资金，大量都投入到了硬件和基础设施建设中。我想从您的角度，在能源方面，

segments.en: do you think enough has been allocated towards some of the sort of periphery support sectors like
segments.zh: 您认为是否有足够的资金配置到一些周边支持性行业，比如

segments.en: energy, like the green transition? I mean, we were already having trouble meeting the climate goals before the AI builds out. And I just wonder whether or not we've had a difficult
segments.zh: 能源，比如绿色转型？我的意思是，在AI建设之前，我们就已经难以实现气候目标了。我只是在想，我们是否已经进行了足够艰难的

segments.en: enough conversation around building the sustainability backbone of this initiative.
segments.zh: 讨论，关于构建这一倡议的可持续性支柱。

segments.en: So, definitely, that's why we have to have these conversations because sometimes when the only focus is on short-term economic profits, that's where we are facing the greatest risks. That's why we need to
segments.zh: 所以，确实，这就是为什么我们必须进行这些对话，因为有时当唯一关注点是短期经济利润时，那就是我们面临最大风险的地方。这就是为什么我们需要

segments.en: take a somewhat more holistic perspective. Ultimately, we as human beings cannot thrive unless we thrive together. So, if everyone is just focusing on short-term gains without looking at
segments.zh: 采取更全面的视角。最终，作为人类，除非我们共同繁荣，否则我们无法繁荣。所以，如果每个人都只关注短期收益而不考虑

segments.en: the role that, how are our well-being, our prosperity as human kind is interconnected, then ultimately, we will all fail. So, I hope that we can have more of these discussions bringing
segments.zh: 我们的福祉、我们人类的繁荣是如何相互关联的，那么最终，我们都会失败。所以，我希望我们能进行更多这样的讨论， bringing

segments.en: business leaders, academic leaders, technologies leaders together so that we can actually make it possible for impact to be measured in every business decision. Otherwise, it would be
segments.zh: 商业领袖、学术领袖、技术领袖齐聚一堂，以便我们能够真正让影响力在每一个商业决策中被衡量。否则，

segments.en: very difficult to let any isolated breakthrough be able to actually solve these problems.
segments.zh: 任何孤立的突破都很难真正解决这些问题。

segments.en: Again, it has to be a collective movement. China is going to be central to this. And we just had
segments.zh: 再次强调，这必须是一场集体运动。中国将在其中发挥核心作用。我们刚刚
